infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MVB uses your camera to take a photo of a beer or drink menu at a bar or restaurant. The photo is sent to an AI service that reads the menu items, prices, and alcohol content to calculate and rank each drink by alcohol-per-dollar value. Photos are not stored on our servers.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MVB accesses your photo library so you can choose an existing photo of a beer or drink menu. The selected photo is sent to an AI service that reads the menu items, prices, and alcohol content to calculate and rank each drink by alcohol-per-dollar value. Photos are not stored on our servers.
